summary: Nordrest Holding AB (publ) operates as a foodservice company in Sweden and internationally. The company operates restaurants. It also provides catering services. In addition, the company develops, produces, packs, and distributes complete meal solutions and food components for defence, emergency preparedness, humanitarian operations, and institutional customers under the OrifO, Surviva foods, and Outmeals names. Further, it provides meal solutions under the Taste by Nordrest, Togo by Nordrest,, PocketbyNordrest, LaGirafe, Dinners, and WayCup brands. The company serves defense, companies, colleges and universities, schools, hospitals and elderly care, and travel groups. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Solna, Sweden.
